listing.name: Naruto: The Broken Bond — Jorge Barbosa Broken Bond Recomp (jorjbarbosa)
listing.summary: Upstream reports about 30 minutes of menus, early Story fights, cutscenes, Fight Mode and open-world play on one Windows 11 PC with an RX 9070 XT. Most of Story, Xbox Live, other GPUs and other revisions remain untested. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own extracted disc files with title ID 55530825, media ID 09FFE047 and executable version 0.0.0.3. default.xex must have SHA-256 8f70e79443e36b38e44b6a105dad51fb8909fb615d982753cabaac9b15f0d576.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the local SDK, code-generation and native Direct3D 12 build scripts. The README says there are no ready-built releases, while a 2026-10-20 release listing showed v0.1.0-beta with three assets. Their purpose is unconfirmed; check the selected release before choosing a package.

warnings: Upstream reports about 30 minutes of menus, early Story fights, cutscenes, Fight Mode and open-world play on one Windows 11 PC with an RX 9070 XT. Most of Story, Xbox Live, other GPUs and other revisions remain untested.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
